articles_reviewed.conclusion: Complete and readable; no material dropped section or argument found. The caution that remainder is not synonymous with victim remains, as do disputed ancient measurements and eligibility evidence limits. Source-level categorical formulations below merit bounded correction, not shortening.

Complete and readable; noticeboard, commercial archive, three watches, measurement-line shift, eligibility/record authority, first retrospective table and admission/cancellation asymmetry all retained. English§3.6 partially improves the source's true-value formulation, but the remaining categorical wording needs consistent qualification.

sources_actually_consulted.type: Primary text in English translation, opened in full browser text and relevant entries actually inspected
sources_actually_consulted.finding: The Olympiad sequence repeatedly names the same victor; entries21/22 and154–157 suffice. It also has attached notices of other events, and entry104 names wrestling while175 uses boys stadion. The source's main catalogue is stadion-oriented, not literally exclusive and without exceptions.
sources_actually_consulted.limits: No fresh collation of Greek, Armenian or manuscript witnesses is claimed.

issues.reason: The actual primary catalogue has additional event notices and exceptional entries. Keep the main stadion chronology point without claiming literally every entry and the entire list contain only that event.
issues.zh_before: 它从第一届排到第二百四十九届，每一届只有一个条目，那一届单程赛跑的冠军姓名。单程赛跑指的是跑完赛道全长的那一项，它是奥林匹亚最古老的项目，也是那张表从头到尾唯一使用的项目。
issues.zh_after: 它从第一届排到第二百四十九届，名录的主干通常按每届单程赛跑的冠军姓名排列。单程赛跑指的是跑完赛道全长的那一项，它是奥林匹亚最古老的项目。名录也有少数例外和其他项目的附记；这里要看的是它用胜者给届次定位的基本方式，而不是一张逐项列出成绩的现代结果表。
issues.en_before: It runs from the first Olympiad to the 249th, with just one entry for each: the name of that Olympiad's winner in the stadion race. This was the race over the full length of the track, Olympia's oldest event and the only event used throughout the list.
issues.en_after: It runs from the first Olympiad to the 249th, its main sequence generally identifying each Olympiad by the winner of the stadion race. This was the race over the full length of the track, Olympia's oldest event. There are occasional exceptions and notices of other events. What matters here is its basic way of locating Olympiads through their victors, rather than producing a modern table of performances in every event.

issues.reason: One champion may win successive Olympiads, as the actual Eusebius text explicitly says. A champion name per dated Olympiad is not a globally unique name.
issues.zh_before: 它需要的就只是每四年一个不重复的名字。
issues.zh_after: 它需要的只是为每一届写下一个冠军姓名；即使同一个人再次夺冠，届次仍能区分年份。
issues.en_before: all it needed was one distinct name every four years.
issues.en_after: all it needed was a champion's name for each Olympiad; the numbered Olympiad still distinguished the date when the same man won again.

issues.reason: Uneven spacing supports the limited claim that these particular markers were not modern precision instruments. It does not establish the only possible explanation or absence of any ancient measurement. The essay itself next acknowledges measurements.
issues.zh_before: 这说明不等距不构成问题，而不构成问题的唯一解释是没有人用它们来量。
issues.zh_after: 这至少说明，这些标志没有承担现代精确测距标记的同一种任务。它支持的，是这里并不以产生可跨场地核对的精确成绩为首要目的，而不是古人从未作过任何测量。
issues.en_before: Unequal spacing therefore posed no problem, and the only explanation for its posing no problem is that no one was using them to measure.
issues.en_after: At least these markers were not doing the same job as modern precision distance markers. The evidence supports a narrower point: producing exact performances for comparison across venues was not their primary purpose. It does not show that the ancients never measured anything.

issues.reason: A surviving isolated measurement does not logically prove the nonexistence of every lost record system. Preserve the actual limitation in the surviving reference material and the central contrast between anecdotal number and routinely checkable institutional data.
issues.zh_before: 零星的数值不是纪录制度存在的证据，是它不存在的证据。
issues.zh_after: 零星的数值不足以证明，一套可以持续核对成绩的纪录制度已经存在。
issues.en_before: Isolated numerical values are not evidence that a record system existed, but evidence of its absence.
issues.en_after: Isolated numerical values do not establish that a system for routinely checking performances already existed.

issues.reason: Unavailable independent evidence is not absence of the race's duration. English already says independently observed, unlike categorical Chinese, but its retrospective true-value sentence remains too strong. Preserve institutional adjudication without claiming instruments create elapsed duration.
issues.zh_before: 这个问题在当时没有答案，而且不是因为技术不够好，是因为在只有人手按表的条件下，并不存在一个独立于观测的时间等在那里被测出来。那一次奔跑确实发生了，而关于它用了多久这件事，除了三个人的三次按压之外没有别的凭据。所谓真值，是后来有了更精密的装置之后才被追溯地设想出来的东西。
issues.zh_after: 凭这三块表，在当时没有办法确定答案。不是那次奔跑没有实际用时，而是在这些手计时记录之外，没有一项足够精确的独立记录可供核对。那一次奔跑确实发生了，而留下来的时间凭据，只有三个人的三次按压。后来有了更精密的装置，人们可以回看这些记录的限度，却不能据此恢复那一跑已经失去的独立计时。
issues.en_before: There was no answer then, and not merely because the technology was insufficiently good. Under conditions of exclusively manual timing, there was no independently observed time waiting to be recovered apart from the observations. The run certainly happened. But for how long it took, there was no evidence beyond those three people's button presses. The so-called true value was something imagined retrospectively after more precise equipment became available.
issues.en_after: Those three watches could not establish the answer at the time. The run had an actual duration, but no sufficiently precise independent record was available against which to check the hand timings. The run certainly happened; the surviving evidence of its duration consisted of those three people's button presses. Later, more precise equipment could expose the limits of such records, but it could not recover an independent timing of that particular race.

issues.reason: No evidence that an unselected reading is inferior does not certify it correct. The important point is procedural rejection versus proven measurement error.
issues.zh_before: 它们不是错的。没有任何证据说那两块表比这一块差。它们只是在一次表决里落败了。
issues.zh_after: 没有被采用，不等于已经被证明错误。这个取数程序本身不能证明，那两块表一定比被采纳的读数差。它们首先是在一次程序裁断里落选了。
issues.en_before: They were not wrong. Nothing proved that those two watches were inferior to the accepted one. They had merely lost a vote.
issues.en_after: Not being selected did not establish that they were wrong. The procedure itself did not prove those two readings inferior to the accepted one. They had first of all lost a procedural decision.

issues.reason: The paragraph two places earlier explicitly says the absence of a located provision does not prove none existed. The unrestricted never-legislated formulation contradicts that careful documentary boundary. Restrict it to the examined authorization clause.
issues.zh_before: 而它从来没有被立法。它活在实践里，活在习惯里，活在所有人的预期里，唯独不在那句授权的条文里。
issues.zh_after: 但至少在这里考察的那句授权条文里，它没有被写出来。它活在实践里，活在习惯里，活在人们的预期里；那一句条文所明确授予的，却只是审议和登记的权力。
issues.en_before: Yet it was never legislated. It lived in practice, habit, and everyone's expectations, but not in the clause conferring authority.
issues.en_after: Yet it does not appear in the authorizing clause examined here. It lived in practice, habit, and people's expectations; that clause explicitly conferred only the powers to consider and register.
